PluginData.Author: Blues-Hailfire
PluginData.Tooltip: Syncs your in-game GPS list and live position to a Discord GPS vault
PluginData.Description:
Automatically syncs your Space Engineers GPS points and live player position to the Space Engineers GPS Manager Discord bot, so your faction's shared GPS vault stays up to date without manually pasting GPS strings.
Configure the bot endpoint, sync token and sync intervals from Pulsar's plugin list: select GPS Vault Sync and click Configure.
